name: The Essence of Aku'Mai
summary: Je'neu Sancrea has found the naga harvesting sapphires in Blackfathom Deeps. At Zoram'gar Outpost, the shaman asks Horde adventurers to recover them before their power is misused.

sections.title: A Threat in the Depths
sections.body: Je'neu Sancrea watches over the Kaldorei ruins from the Zoram Strand. Naga now mine sapphire clusters in the submerged chambers of Blackfathom Deeps, where the gems grow along damp cavern walls. Sancrea senses the serpentine invaders mean to harness their power and seeks to stop the harvest before they can use it.

sections.title: Water Spirits and Arcane Power
sections.body: The Sapphires of Aku'mai carry elemental water energy and hold clinging water spirits. Adept sorcerers could use them to fuel dangerous arcane rituals or strengthen Aku'mai, the shadowy hydra whose presence fills the subterranean temple. Recovering the clusters keeps this potent reagent from the naga and helps guard the coastline against unchecked elemental magic.

faq.answer: Je'neu Sancrea, a Darkspear troll shaman, gives the request at Zoram'gar Outpost on the Zoram Strand in north-western Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why do the naga want the Sapphires of Aku'Mai?
faq.answer: The naga's exact purpose is unknown, but the sapphires hold potent elemental water energy and raw magical power that could fuel their spells.

faq.q: Where are the sapphire clusters found?
faq.answer: Sapphire clusters line the cavern walls and floors in Blackfathom Deeps' outer tunnels and flooded passages, just inside the ruined underground entrance along the Zoram Strand.
Aku'mai is a monstrous three-headed hydra dwelling deep within the submerged temple ruins. Twilight's Hammer cultists revere him as a servant of the Old Gods.

faq.q: Do I have to kill any dungeon bosses for this quest?
aliases: do i need a full group
faq.answer: No. The sapphire clusters grow in the earlier submerged tunnels, before you encounter Blackfathom Deeps' main bosses.

faq.q: Does this quest connect to any other storyline?
faq.answer: Yes. It follows 'Trouble in the Deeps' and continues Je'neu Sancrea's investigation into the rising darkness and cultist activity in Blackfathom Deeps.

angles.text: As a shaman, you can sense the restless water spirits bound within the crystals, a warning of corrupted elemental forces beneath the temple.
As a member of the Horde, you help guard the perilous foothold at Zoram'gar Outpost by keeping nearby naga from gaining raw magical power.
As a troll, you can look to Je'neu Sancrea, an observant Darkspear mystic who relies on communion with the spirits and ancestral wisdom to face the strange threats of Kalimdor.
